reviewed_semantics: capture receives one real R, takes mapping and walk plus stop-follow snapshots under that SAME R epoch/sequence/tail, captures genuine per-executing-Thread Operation leases without allocation, explicitly finishes mapping and error-path snapshots before R releases. GroupRead/HardwareLeases drops occur after R is gone on ordinary returns, preventing recursive R acquisition.

Each next topology step is taken under short R then releases it before Event S. Matching LocalRuntime/physical counter index come from genuine HardwareLeases key/token, never measurement count or stale origin index. RuntimeWindow drops before S. Usercopy occurs only after all local R/S windows have ended; leases/snapshot refs protect storage across copy faults.

Start preserves original inactive/mask conditions, attr exclusion modes, period-before-counter-set order and deliberately ignored signed counter-set status before mask/ACTIVE. TSC arithmetic reuses exact helper. Extra template is sampled under S, S drops before R-taking reserve_extra, and reenters for allocation-free actual MSR programming. Only newly reserved AND unprogrammed extra bits are aborted after S; programmed/foreign/old bits are never guessed free.

Reset preserves invariant TSC base/stopped/accumulator arithmetic and physical mask checks; ordinary counters perform genuine read/update before atomic count zero. value_window passes the actual executing/scheduler-owned Thread explicitly rather than nested CPU-current lookup.

Stop reuses exact state/mask/TSC/stopped-array helper, preserving65 pointer capacity. It stops the entire computed physical mask before updating each actually stopped event, using a third same-initial-epoch snapshot and matching S/RuntimeWindow for each update. Real Process association detach and PP_NONE belong to the common owner only after success.

Sync keeps original inherit/pid need check, leader pid action and early NONE stop; sibling action uses original INPUT pid rather than substituting each sibling pid. Real atomic/count and physical counter providers remain genuine and serialized by S.

Read-one captures that exact pinned event even if logical close has omitted it from newer topology. Group read emits captured members+leader count and leader-first values, one header then one-word siblings, genuine EFAULT behavior/wrapping pointer and original CInt→CLong return boundary. No raw mutable C list is traversed.

Actual source checks contain no allocator, blocking wait, host offload or usercopy under P/R/S. Called provider paths are bounded genuine arithmetic/atomic/PMC/MSR operations. Whole callback/callsite and final provider selection remain separate coherent-source/image obligations.
